_note: Both `inputs` and `reference` are the SAME file: the real64 replay's own dump, which carries the cuadjtqn tape (input state, mid state, final state) as well as the kernel's outputs. The tape rows are (call, column) pairs flattened together; a mode's rows are selected by its kcall code and by the ldflag the Fortran passed, because a call with ldflag false leaves its state untouched and is not an adjustment at all. Column tolerances are ABSOLUTE, 1e-9 of the sampled profile's own maximum.

tests.description: The ENVIRONMENT (kcall = 0) mode of cuadjtqn, on 48 of the calls WRF's own New Tiedtke made at one model step -- the unconditional two-step form `cuinin` uses to put the half-level environment on its saturation curve. Reference run: the idealized single-column chem170 run of data/eqwefic/notes/chem170_scm_reference_run.md (em_scm_xy, Weisman-Klemp sounding over Kansas, 1997-06-20 12 UTC + 48 h, dx = 20 km, 59 levels, dt = 60 s, cu_physics = 16), step 1: 06 LST, deep convection (ktype 1), the strongest convective step of the run: cloud base at kernel level 44, top at 5, |rthcuten| up to 2.6e-2 K/s and 0.49 mm of convective rain over the step. Reference build: the real64 (kind_phys = real64) replay of that step through kernels/ntiedtke_driver of WRF fork branch earthsciml-instrumented-chem170, with the seven constants cu_ntiedtke_init takes (cp, R_d, R_v, L_v, L_s, L_f, g) supplied at binary64 precision -- they are ARGUMENTS, so that is what a double-precision reference means, and it is what lib/wrf_constants.esm carries. The scheme's OWN parameter block is a separate matter and stays at its binary32 roundings (FORTRAN_BUGS N108). The values are a TAPE of every cuadjtqn invocation of the step, added to the diagnostic kernel for this component: nothing else publishes them, because they are in-place updates of arrays the caller owns and are overwritten many times before cumastrn returns. The tape records the input state, the state after the FIRST Newton step and the final state, so each half of the two-step adjustment is pinned separately rather than only their composition. The 48 calls are sampled evenly along the SORTED input temperature, so the ice branch, the mixed-phase ramp and the water branch of the phase weight are all exercised in every test rather than whichever the tape happened to start with. These are algebraic observeds at t = 0 and the document has no ODE state, so the empty time_span is a single static evaluation.

These are algebraic observeds at t = 0 and the document has no ODE state, so the empty time_span is a single static evaluation.
